items.title: Energy Transition Update - Holu Hou Energy Revolutionizes MDU Solar Adoption
items.summary: Holu Hou Energy has launched the HoluPower 3.0, a solar energy storage system designed for its "EnergyCluster" platform, which targets multi-dwelling unit (MDU) housing. This development aims to overcome historical barriers to solar adoption in the MDU segment by offering a modular and cost-effective energy storage solution.
